$$$TRACE("web service login...") if pRequest.StringValue="" { $$$TRACE("Empty reuest, ignored...") set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).InputDataError(..%ConfigName, " Request is empty... ") Quit %objlasterror } Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("login",.result,..usrNm,..pswrd) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC $$$TRACE("get response...") set lq = ##class(Request.loginRequest).%New() Set tSC = lq.NewResponse(.pResp) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set pResp.result=$get(result) set pResponse = ##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New() set pResponse.StringValue=pResp.result.sessionId
$$$TRACE("Server Url: "_pResp.result.serverUrl) set ss=##class(SF.tns.SessionHeader).%New() set ss.sessionId=pResp.result.sessionId set ss.mustUnderstand=1 set ..Adapter.WebServiceURL=pResp.result.serverUrl set iCnt= ..Adapter.%Client.HeadersIn.Count() do ..Adapter.%Client.HeadersOut.SetAt(ss,"SessionHeader") set oCnt= ..Adapter.%Client.HeadersOut.Count() $$$TRACE("Header Count: "_iCnt_":"_oCnt) set updateContact = ##class(SF.ens.sObject).%New() $$$TRACE("Set sObject type to Contact: ") set updateContact.type="Contact" set id=##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Piece(pRequest.StringValue,";",1) set msprId=##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Piece(pRequest.StringValue,";",2) set usrNm=##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Piece(pRequest.StringValue,";",3) set updateContact.Id=id $$$TRACE("set MSPR_ID__c="_msprId) $$$TRACE("set Enterprise_Username__c="_usrNm) do updateContact.any.Insert("<MSPR_ID__c>"_msprId_"</MSPR_ID__c>") do updateContact.any.Insert("<Enterprise_Username__c>"_usrNm_"</Enterprise_Username__c>") set contacts=##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() $$$TRACE("Insert updateContact to the object list...") do contacts.Insert(updateContact)
$$$TRACE("Invoke Method...: ")
Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("update",.qresult,contacts) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC $$$TRACE("Getting records... ") set qReq=##class(Request.updateRequest).%New() Set tSC = qReq.NewResponse(.qRep) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set qRep.result=$get(qresult)
$$$TRACE("Result Count: "_qRep.result.Count())
set rCnt=qRep.result.Count() set emsg="" for i=1:1:rCnt { set tRes=qRep.result.GetAt(i) if (tRes.success) { $$$TRACE("Updated id: "_tRes.id_" successfully!") set pResponse.StringValue="Update id: "_tRes.id_" with mspr_id and user name successfully!" } else { $$$TRACE("Error Count: "_tRes.errors.Count()) set recCnt=tRes.errors.Count() set emsg="ERROR: " for j=1:1:recCnt { set tRec=tRes.errors.GetAt(j) set emsg=emsg_tRec.message_", " $$$TRACE("Error message: "_tRec.message) } set pResponse.StringValue="Update id: "_tRes.id_" failed, "_emsg } } if emsg'="" { set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).FailMsgError(..%ConfigName, emsg) Quit %objlasterror }
Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("logout") $$$TRACE("Logout successful...")
Quit $$$OK
